_howToEdit: The three matcha personas. 'q1Answer' is the answer to Question 1 that leads to this persona. 'variant' is the blend/level used for this persona's drinks. 'bolderVariant' (optional) is the version suggested as the second pick when someone answers 'A bolder version of my usual'.

personas.name: Matcha Curious
personas.headline: You're a Matcha Curious!
personas.explainShort: You like matcha smooth and sweet, with the creaminess up front.
personas.explainLong: You like matcha smooth and sweet, with the creaminess up front. Dachi Blend Level 1 keeps the matcha gentle, so every sip is easy to enjoy.

personas.name: Matcha Craver
personas.headline: You're a Matcha Craver!
personas.explainShort: You want to really taste the matcha, still sweet and creamy.
personas.explainLong: You want to really taste the matcha. Dachi Blend Level 2 gives you a stronger, more pronounced matcha flavor while keeping the sweet, creamy body you like.

personas.name: Matcha Aficionado
personas.headline: You're a Matcha Aficionado!
personas.explainShort: You enjoy matcha for its own character: nutty, umami and layered.
personas.explainLong: You enjoy matcha for its own character: nutty, umami and layered. Japan Blend is first-harvest matcha from Izumo, Shimane, from the Okumidori and Samidori cultivars.

explanationDepth._howToEdit: Question 4 (familiarity) sets how much the result screen explains. It never changes which persona or drink is recommended.

levelPrimer: At Matchadachi, Level 1 and Level 2 tell you how strong the matcha is in your Dachi Blend drink. Japan Blend is a separate first-harvest matcha with a nuttier, umami taste. They are different tastes, and none is better than another.
